data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences, a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church, has raised $555M+ to date. The peer universe for valuation comprises 3 public comparables in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers at same or adjacent stages, including Chai Discovery, New Limit, and Eikon Therapeutics.

The Stage-Progression method is not applicable; the reported $10.3B post-money valuation from the last round appears to exceed reasonable bounds at over 20x total capital raised, suggesting a data integrity issue. The Public-Comp Anchoring method cannot be applied due to the absence of disclosed revenue figures, though the sector median P/S multiple stands at 6.6x across the three public comps. The only reliable triangulation method is Peer-Median, which identifies three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables with valuations ranging from $539M (Eikon Therapeutics, Series B) to $3.8B (Chai Discovery, Series C), yielding a median of $3.1B.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $2.6B to $3.6B, with a median point of $3.1B. Key uncertainties include the company's undisclosed revenue profile—which would enable public-comp anchoring—and the limited granularity of the private peer set. Stage and capital-intensity differences within the peer group also introduce variance in defensibility.
